title: An asymptotic-preserving adjoint unified gas kinetic scheme for sensitivity analysis
summary: High-dimensional sensitivity analysis and uncertainty quantification for multiscale gas dynamics, spanning the continuum to rarefied regimes, require computationally efficient and mathematically consistent gradient evaluation. This paper develops a discrete adjoint method for the unified gas-kinetic scheme (UGKS) based on a dual-consistent formulation. The adjoint system is derived directly from the discrete microscopic velocity-distribution equation coupled with the macroscopic-moment compatibility conditions.
